summary: Concise, artifact‑grounded closure review of a preregistered paired experiment comparing a G‑V‑R pipeline to direct LLM generation over 300 NetOps tasks. The run executed as preregistered; all 300 shared initial candidates passed the deterministic validator so the bounded repair step was never invoked. The manuscript and archived artifacts transparently report the null outcome, provide detailed provenance and hashes, and address prior reviewer requests about per‑vendor tests by stating zero discordant pairs per vendor and citing the canonical manifest artifact. No critical defects remain.
optional_revisions: Include a compact per‑vendor summary table (vendor name → task count → n11,n10,n01,n00) drawn directly from execution/task_manifest.jsonl (SHA‑256 = 6d99060659a7...) to help readers assess external validity without reprocessing the manifest.

In the Methods or Disclosure, add one sentence enumerating which validator checks are intentionally excluded (e.g., dynamic emulation, full routing convergence equivalence) to further sharpen construct‑validity limits already discussed.

Optionally note in Results that repair_call_count = 0 and give its artifact path/hash (execution/execution_manifest.json) as an explicit numeric check (readers can already derive this, but an explicit one‑line statement improves clarity).
